verdict.rationale: The evidence describes PayPal implementing other companies' protocols (OpenAI's ACP, Google's UCP) as a payment backend via Braintree, and PayPal's own agentic-commerce surfaces (Store Sync, cart API, agent toolkit) are form-gated, vendor-controlled integrations rather than an open protocol with independent third-party implementers. There is no evidence that any independent party besides PayPal has implemented PayPal's own agentic-commerce protocol or platform — it reads as a private, gated integration model, not an ecosystem.
